comment: The 2 real ESP32-C5 boards currently flashed with firmware/csi_transceiver (all-transceiver mode, NUM_SENDERS=2). Each physical board appears twice: once as a receiver entry (its serial port) and once as a sender entry (its MAC), at the same position, so Room.links() produces the full bidirectional pair automatically -- see docs/design/transceiver-room-config.md.
